message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.68,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked or scored vote treats the three budget options equally and captures preferences beyond a simple majority, while requiring transparent criteria for public benefit, feasibility, and sustainability.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Supports allocating the full 3,000 euros to expanding the children’s book collection.","influence":0.33},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Supports allocating the full 3,000 euros to creating a public-access digital space with computers.","influence":0.33},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Supports splitting the budget equally between the book collection and digital space.","influence":0.34}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The three options reflect legitimate but competing public-service priorities, with no clear debate winner. Use a transparent multi-criteria social-choice process, including needs assessment and total-cost estimates, then prefer a compromise or staged allocation if it achieves broad support and remains financially viable."}
